about: Words a press never reads (code plan 6.16, Julian, 28 October 2026). One list for every check: the platform's own pages and emails (plain-words/plainWords.test.js), the shop's admin (apps/shop/src/app/admin/platformPlainWords.test.ts) and the stockroom (apps/stockroom/tests/platformPlainWords.test.js). Add to it freely; never weaken it. A word used in a plain, non-technical sense is allowed only in the checking test that reads it, with a comment saying why.
